title: Windows host became unresponsive at low CPU/disk and needed a hard reset (2026-10-23 ~15:37–15:46Z) — cause unknown
outcome: The cause of the 2026-10-23 Windows hang (unresponsive while CPU and disk use were low, ended by a hard reset) is identified from evidence, or the missing evidence is named and a capture is in place for a recurrence. No attribution is made to load, the full gate, Engram or the persistence writer without evidence.
acceptance: A note records the read-only evidence available after the reset: System and Application event logs around the hang, crash-dump and LiveKernelReports folders, TermAl's run and launcher records, and Engram's diagnostics. It states what each shows and what is missing.

If no evidence identifies a cause, a recurrence capture is proposed (for example a hang-dump or ETW configuration) and approved by Greg before it is enabled, since enabling it is a system configuration change.
Every in-flight gate, test run, review delegation and evaluation interrupted by the reset is listed with its recovery disposition.
disposal_reason: Cancelled under Greg's word of 2026-11-08 (Asistant #1015). Not fixed and not explained. Per Sol-c593's read-only sweep: no code landing, bounded OS, run and I/O triage delivered, and the historical hang cause is UNKNOWN. No new occurrence is reported in my records and nothing further can be investigated without one. If a Windows host hangs at low CPU and disk again, file a new item with fresh evidence.
